purpose: Source-scoped Saab factory automatic family identification overlay on independently compiled US production groups; not original VIN validation or interchange approval.

research_sources.title: 9-3 9400 MY2001 type designation, gearbox
research_sources.scope_note: Factory WIS identifies AF20 and AF22 four-speed families; FA44 is an example type code, not a universal application.

research_sources.title: 9-5 9600 MY2000 automatic AF30 / FA47
research_sources.scope_note: WIS identifies AF30 4-speed, factory type designation example FA47 and gearbox model 50-40LE. Source is MY2000.

research_sources.title: 9-5 9600 MY2008 FA57 type designation
research_sources.scope_note: WIS states original 9-5 automatic from MY2002 has FA57 designation; not a 9-3 interchange permission.

research_sources.title: 9-3 9440 MY2006 FA57 type designations
research_sources.scope_note: WIS says 9-3 9440 B207 automatic from MY2003 uses FA57; TCM engine adaptation codes differ.

research_sources.title: 9-3 9440 MY2006 AF40 six-speed type designations
research_sources.scope_note: WIS designates six-speed as AF40 / Aisin TF-80SC; cannot assume identical boxed assemblies for other cars.

research_sources.title: TA440-0902 AF40 ATF level technical advice
research_sources.publisher: Saab technical advice mirrored by WIS
research_sources.scope_note: January 2009 bulletin: low ATF can produce delayed shifts; use original fluid/temperature procedures and Tech2. Not automatic proof of a failed transmission.

research_sources.title: 9-3 9440 FA57 adaptation reset procedure
research_sources.scope_note: Saab requires Tech2 reset/re-adaptation after certain transmission, TCM or software changes. Never reset as a substitute for fault diagnosis.

research_sources.title: 9-5 9600 FA57 2004 hydraulic pressure solenoids
research_sources.scope_note: P0748 (SLT) and P0785 (SLS) documented limp-home faults; diagnosis required before deciding on transmission replacement.

diagnostic_cautions.claim: FA57 label exists on both original 9-5 9600 and 9-3 9440.
diagnostic_cautions.decision: Do NOT claim interchangeability, identical application calibration, donor compatibility or fluid spec across platforms.

diagnostic_cautions.claim: Saab technical advice connects low AF40 ATF level to delayed gear engagement/shift.
diagnostic_cautions.decision: Before classifying a delayed-shift AF40 vehicle as needing a rebuild, obtain Tech2 readings and professional fluid-level/temperature assessment to the exact WIS procedure.

diagnostic_cautions.claim: Saab WIS instructs Tech2 adaptation after transmission, TCM or software changes for 9440 FA57.
diagnostic_cautions.decision: Investigate calibration/adaptation history and codes before diagnosing internal gearbox failure. Do not claim all hard shifts are adaptive.

diagnostic_cautions.claim: 2004 WIS links SLT/SLS pressure solenoid faults to P0748/P0785 and limp-home.
diagnostic_cautions.decision: Read transmission DTCs, wiring and solenoid fault procedures before declaring the entire gearbox damaged.
